title: equisetum hyemale var. elongatum
intro: Equisetum hyemale var. elongatum, commonly known as Scouring Rush, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the Equisetum genus, which is often referred to as horsetails. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Scouring Rush include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve wound healing, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Equisetum hyemale var. elongatum include silicates, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
